annotations.text:
CORE JOURNEY — read left to right, top to bottom.
Home → Confirm → You & preference → Matchmaking → Match Found → Chat → Prompts → End Chat → Post-Shit.

Direction — beige and brown.
Warm paper ground, chocolate fills, a burnt-sienna highlight, clay for the other person. Cards lift off the page by a shade and a hairline. The UI still plays it straight; the copy carries the joke.

Type: Bricolage Grotesque (display) · Space Grotesk (UI) · JetBrains Mono (timers, IDs, labels).

Gender is set once at entry (screen 3) and then surfaces where it matters: as a filter chip on matchmaking, as a tag on the match card, and in the anonymous identity line in chat. Nothing else about a person is ever shown.
SECONDARY — anonymous stats and the global board. Deliberately not a social profile: no photo, no followers, no bio, a one-tap new identity, and matching preference editable from here.
Alternates, low-fi. A is the original dark/lime treatment, kept for comparison. B trades the joke for clinical restraint. C goes full meme-poster — louder screenshots, harder to live in day to day.
